explore_prose: Every run in this experiment is in the explorer below: filter by outcome to see which settings held the SLOs, or by setting to compare one sweep against another.
Each sweep's hypothesis was written before the runs, and is quoted beside that sweep's measured result below.

hero.html: 52 configurations over 8 sweeps (topology-pp, topology-dp, batch-caps, kv-capacity, moe-collective, routing-prefix-cache, prefill-chunking, cudagraph), each at 5 load levels, every run on exactly 8 GPUs.
1x TP8 + EP (gpu mem util 0.95 · KV dtype fp8), from the kv-capacity sweep, reached 37.41 tok/s/accelerator (299.3 tok/s across the fleet) at concurrency 64 while holding the scenario's SLOs.
1x TP8 + EP (gpu mem util 0.95 · KV dtype fp8) at concurrency 64. 255 of 260 runs held the SLOs.

meta: deterministic sweep — no LLM in the measurement path
recommendation_prose: The table below ranks the measured operating points by output tok/s per accelerator, the objective this experiment selects on, among runs that held the scenario's SLOs.

prose: TP8 should peak highest, since every pipeline stage adds a boundary hop to each decode step.
Measured: best was 1x TP8 + EP at 31.79 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 32).
sections.title: Sweep: topology-pp

prose: Data-parallel attention should beat pipeline stages at the same tp, and EP should matter more at dp 4 than dp 2.
Measured: best was 1x TP4xDP2 + EP at 18.59 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 32).
sections.title: Sweep: topology-dp

prose: A seq cap of 8 should bind on TP8 but not on TP2 DP4, whose four attention ranks each see a quarter of the lanes.
Measured: best was 1x TP8 + EP (max seqs 16 · batch tokens 4,096) at 31.26 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 32).
sections.title: Sweep: batch-caps

prose: fp8 KV and higher memory utilization should substitute on TP8 but add on TP2 DP4, which replicates attention weights.
Measured: best was 1x TP8 + EP (gpu mem util 0.95 · KV dtype fp8) at 37.41 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 64).
sections.title: Sweep: kv-capacity

prose: DeepEP low-latency should win on TP8, and the gap should shrink on TP2 DP4, where sequence-parallel MoE splits the batch.
Measured: best was 1x TP8 + EP at 31.79 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 32).
sections.title: Sweep: moe-collective

prose: prefix-affinity should only beat random with caching on, since a cold instance re-prefills the whole shared context.
Measured: best was 2x TP2 + EP (prefix-affinity routing) at 5.21 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 16).
sections.title: Sweep: routing-prefix-cache

prose: Capping long prefills should trade a little peak throughput for a much lower ITL p99 at saturation.
Measured: best was 1x TP8 + EP (prefill chunk 8,192) at 31.79 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 32).
sections.title: Sweep: prefill-chunking

prose: FULL-family capture should beat the PIECEWISE default by a few percent, and NONE should collapse.
Measured: best was 1x TP8 + EP (graph capture full) at 32.23 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 32).
sections.title: Sweep: cudagraph
